coreLoop: Enter a short competitive encounter, read opponent movement, and use movement, attacks, aim, abilities, or combos to create an advantage.
Damage or eliminate opponents, receive clear hit and score feedback, then reposition around cooldowns, cover, objectives, or team pressure.
Complete the round or score target, receive progression or loadout rewards, and re-enter a new match with a changed tactical choice or mastery goal.
content.progressionDirection: Progression is based on the player's performance in the core loop, with rewards and loadouts that enhance their skills and abilities.
content.visualDirection: The game features a visually rich and immersive world with a unique art style that enhances the combat and opponent experience.
